$comment: product-registry/1 — the image-gen knowledge graph's per-brand product index. Each product carries the exact reference images an image call (gpt-image-2 / Nano Banana / gpt-image-1) should be handed, with a role per file: canonical = product/label truth, shape = container geometry only, style = approved look/scene anchor, logo = brand mark, approved-output = a shipped deliverable reusable as a layout/style ref. Paths are repo-relative; many collections are local-only (gitignored by the curated allowlist) — the tracked mirror layer is Brand Context/assets/<Brand>/. Registered in knowledge/graph.json (sources + a product-registry node), so `npm run content -- knowledge query` retrieves entries by text. See docs/IMAGE_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.md.
